SELECTED_INDEX: 9
CONFIDENCE: 0.58
EXPLANATION: The dominant 1644 cm⁻¹ band is consistent with an amide C=O (amide I) or conjugated C=N stretch; candidate 9 (CC=NC(C)=O) contains both an amide carbonyl and an imine, matching a single strong band in this region better than ester/acid candidates, which should show a distinct ~1710–1750 cm⁻¹ carbonyl not observed. The CH stretches at 2923, 2955, 2989, and a weak sp² =C–H near 3056 cm⁻¹ fit a vinyl-imine system (GFQ-003). The 1378 and 1421 cm⁻¹ bands match CH₃ deformations, and the 1243/1168/1083 cm⁻¹ features are consistent with C–N/C–C skeletal modes typical of amide/imine compounds. Absence of nitro asymmetric ~1520 cm⁻¹ disfavors 8; lack of aldehyde C–H (~2720/2820) and extra C=O bands disfavors 1 and 2; lack of a strong ester/acid C=O near ~1730 cm⁻¹ and OH stretch disfavors 5 and 10; hydrocarbon-only 7 does not account for the 1200–1100 cm⁻¹ features.
